column1: # comment: "GMEOW sign-system and script \u2192 Lexvo alignments \u2014 the ISO 639 language-code and ISO 15924 script-code hub (which also anchors the BCP-47 primary subtags; by reference, curl-validated). A Lexvo ISO-code IRI is a code-scoped identifier, a related resource rather than identity (skos:relatedMatch)."

column7: lexvo:iso639-3/eng is the Lexvo resource for the ISO 639-3 code eng (ISO 639-1 en) — the ISO 639 language-code identity for English. A code-scoped identifier, a related resource rather than identity, so skos:relatedMatch.
lexvo:script/Latn is the Lexvo resource for the ISO 15924 script code Latn — the code-scoped identifier for the Latin script. A related resource rather than identity, so skos:relatedMatch.
